themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems that can independently plan, execute, and adapt research tasks, often acting as autonomous agents in research processes.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and optimize code, acting as intelligent coding partners.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research, replicating human behavior for studies.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered software and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large volumes of text, research papers, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's capability to create new content, such as text, images, or code, often for design and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in various stages of the design and research process, from ideation to execution.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and assess the performance and utility of different AI tools for research and design.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the research, capabilities, limitations, and impact of conversational AI agents like chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is affecting job roles, skills, and the overall structure of the workforce, with a research perspective.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
